carrierOnboarding.connectIntro: Clox pays your transport company through a secure Stripe page (not on this Clox screen). You will enter your business details and the bank account where job money should go. This only needs to be done once.
carrierOnboarding.connectMockIntro: This environment is in practice mode. You do not open a real Stripe page. Click the first button, then click Continue so onboarding can proceed.
carrierOnboarding.connectMockHint: Practice mode — no real bank details or money moves.
carrierOnboarding.connectBeforeTitle: Have these ready before you start
carrierOnboarding.connectBeforeItem1: Your Australian Business Number (ABN) — example: 51 824 753 556 (same ABN you entered on the Legal step).
carrierOnboarding.connectBeforeItem2: Legal company name — exactly as registered (example: Acme Haulage Pty Ltd).
carrierOnboarding.connectBeforeItem3: Business bank account in the company name — BSB and account number (example: BSB 062-000, account 1234 5678). Personal accounts may be rejected.
carrierOnboarding.connectBeforeItem4: Business street address in Australia (example: 12 Industrial Rd, Dandenong VIC 3175).
carrierOnboarding.connectBeforeItem5: Photo ID for a company director or authorised person — Australian driver licence or passport (Stripe may ask you to take a photo or upload it).
carrierOnboarding.connectHow1: Click “Open secure payout setup” below. A new browser tab opens on Stripe’s website.
carrierOnboarding.connectHow2: If nothing opens, your browser blocked the pop-up — use the orange “Open Stripe page again” link that appears on this screen.
carrierOnboarding.connectHow3: On Stripe: confirm your business type (usually Company), ABN, legal name, and address. Use the same details as on Clox.
carrierOnboarding.connectHow4: Add the bank account for payouts — enter BSB and account number carefully. Double-check the digits.
carrierOnboarding.connectHow5: If Stripe asks for ID or a document, upload a clear photo of the director’s licence or passport. Wait until Stripe shows the step as complete.
carrierOnboarding.connectHow6: When Stripe says you are finished (or “return to Clox”), close that tab and come back to this Clox page.
carrierOnboarding.connectHow7: Click “I’ve finished on Stripe — continue”. If Clox says payouts are not ready yet, wait a minute, finish any remaining Stripe steps, then try Continue again.
carrierOnboarding.connectMockHow1: Click “Open secure payout setup” (this only marks practice payouts as started).
carrierOnboarding.connectMockHow2: You will not fill real bank details in practice mode.
carrierOnboarding.connectMockHow3: Click “I’ve finished on Stripe — continue” to move to the Fleet step.
carrierOnboarding.connectTipBody: Keep this Clox tab open. Do all bank and ID steps in the Stripe tab. Clox never asks for your full card PIN or internet-banking password.
